import { themeStorage } from '@/lib/theme/theme-storage'; const applyTheme = (theme) => { if (theme === 'dark') { document.documentElement.classList.add('dark'); } else if (theme === 'light') { document.documentElement.classList.add('light'); } else if (theme === 'system') { // system or null - check system preference if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches) { document.documentElement.classList.add('dark'); } else { document.documentElement.classList.add('light'); } } }; themeStorage.getValue().then(applyTheme);
